snippet.title: Dismal Night | Official Trailer | 2D Folk Horror Game Set in 1990s Poland
snippet.description:
Poland, 1996. A man has vanished near a house in the woods that has stood empty for years. Or so the whole village says.

🎮 Wishlist Dismal Night on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3924650/
🗓 Release: 16 December 2026 on Steam

Police officer Tomasz follows the trail to Ciemnolas, a village that would rather stay silent. Explore, question the locals, keep every clue in your police notebook and solve puzzles to uncover what really happened in the house in the woods.

Dismal Night is a story-driven 2D folk horror mystery game, about 3 hours long, made by a solo indie developer from Poland. A psychological horror and detective adventure set in the 1990s, inspired by Slavic folklore and the Polish countryside.

🎧 Full voice acting in English and Polish
💬 Subtitles in 8 languages: turn them on with the CC button (English, Polski, Français, Deutsch, Español, Čeština, Português do Brasil, Português de Portugal)
🖥 Windows, macOS, Linux and Steam Deck

Follow the game:
Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/dismalnightgame/
TikTok: https://www.tiktok.com/@dismalnightgame

#DismalNight #HorrorGame #IndieGame
